title: Granules Pharmaceuticals Inc., FEI 3011585184 — March 30–April 3, 2026 Inspection, Laboratory Investigations, and Product Identification

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Records relating to FDA's March 30–April 3, 2026 inspection of:

Firm: Granules Pharmaceuticals Inc.
FEI: 3011585184
Address: 3701 Concorde Parkway, Chantilly, VA 20151
Inspection dates: March 30–April 3, 2026
Program area: Human drug manufacturing / current good manufacturing practices (CGMP)

I specifically request records underlying Observations 1 and 2 of the FDA Form 483 issued following this inspection, particularly records concerning laboratory investigations, impurity findings, potency or assay failures, and related manufacturing or quality-control deficiencies.

Please provide:

The final Establishment Inspection Report (EIR), including available exhibits, attachments, and supporting documentation relating to Observations 1 and 2.

Records sufficient to identify the pharmaceutical products, active ingredients, dosage forms, strengths, batch or lot numbers, and relevant manufacturing dates associated with the deficiencies cited in Observations 1 and 2.

Laboratory investigation reports, out-of-specification or out-of-trend investigations, deviation reports, and analytical results specifically referenced in or relied upon by FDA investigators in documenting Observations 1 and 2.

Records concerning the identification, characterization, investigation, or proposed root causes of the impurity findings and potency or assay failures associated with those observations.

Granules Pharmaceuticals' written responses to Observations 1 and 2, including corrective and preventive action plans, root-cause analyses, and documentation submitted to FDA supporting implementation of corrective actions.

FDA's written assessments of the firm's responses and corrective actions, including any subsequent correspondence or records documenting verification of corrective actions.

Records specifically discussing whether the deficiencies identified in Observations 1 and 2 affected amphetamine and dextroamphetamine extended-release capsules, other extended-release pharmaceutical products, or manufacturing processes shared with those products.

For items 5–7, please search records dated April 3, 2026, through October 21, 2026.

I recognize that some responsive records may contain confidential commercial information. I request release of all reasonably segregable nonexempt information, particularly product identities, inspection findings, and FDA's conclusions regarding compliance and corrective actions to the extent legally disclosable.

If the requested EIR has not yet been finalized, please provide other responsive, releasable records and identify the status of the EIR.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Emma Yasinski

title: Granules Pharmaceuticals Generic Adderall XR Recall, August 2025 — Investigation, Testing, and Corrective Actions

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

records concerning the recall initiated or reported in August 2025 involving generic Adderall XR (amphetamine and dextroamphetamine extended-release capsules) manufactured or distributed by Granules Pharmaceuticals Inc. or its affiliated entities.

The manufacturing establishment of particular interest is:

Firm: Granules Pharmaceuticals Inc.
FEI: 3011585184
Address: 3701 Concorde Parkway, Chantilly, VA 20151
Product: Amphetamine and dextroamphetamine extended-release capsules (generic Adderall XR)
Relevant period: January 1, 2025, through October 21, 2026

I request:

FDA's recall case file, including the recall event report, health hazard evaluation, recall classification documentation, recall strategy, effectiveness-check records, and termination or status documentation, if available.

Records identifying the affected products, strengths, NDCs, manufacturing lots, expiration dates, and quantities distributed or recalled.

The firm's written explanation of the reason for the recall, including available investigation reports, root-cause analyses, and corrective and preventive action plans submitted to FDA.

Analytical testing records submitted to or generated by FDA concerning the affected lots, including assay, potency, dissolution, content uniformity, impurity, stability, or other quality-control results relevant to the recall.

FDA correspondence with Granules Pharmaceuticals or its affiliates concerning the investigation, scope, cause, or expansion of the recall and the adequacy of proposed corrective actions.

FDA assessments, memoranda, or correspondence evaluating whether the underlying quality problem affected additional lots, strengths, products, or manufacturing processes.

Records documenting FDA's evaluation of whether the corrective actions addressing the recall were completed or effective.

Please include responsive records held by the Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) and other FDA offices involved in the recall.

I request all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions of responsive records and electronic delivery whenever possible.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Emma Yasinski

title: Granules Pharmaceuticals Inc., FEI 3011585184 — July 2022 and December 2023 Inspection Records and Corrective Actions

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

FDA inspections of the following drug manufacturing establishment:

Firm: Granules Pharmaceuticals Inc.
FEI: 3011585184
Address: 3701 Concorde Parkway, Chantilly, VA 20151
Inspection end dates: July 22, 2022, and December 15, 2023
Program area: Human drug manufacturing / current good manufacturing practices (CGMP)

For each inspection, I request:

The final Establishment Inspection Report (EIR), including available exhibits, attachments, and inspectional findings.

The firm's written response to FDA Form 483, including initial responses, supplemental responses, and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans submitted to FDA.

Documentation submitted by the firm supporting implementation or completion of proposed corrective actions, including relevant root-cause analyses, revised procedures, investigation summaries, effectiveness checks, and supporting correspondence.

FDA's written evaluations or assessments of the firm's responses and proposed corrective actions, including records indicating whether the responses were considered adequate, inadequate, or in need of further verification.

Correspondence between FDA and Granules Pharmaceuticals concerning the cited deficiencies, corrective actions, implementation deadlines, follow-up inspections, and verification of corrective actions.

Final inspection classification records and associated classification memoranda, including any records explaining the basis for the final classification or subsequent compliance decisions.

For item 5, please search correspondence dated July 22, 2022, through December 31, 2024, relating to either inspection.

I am particularly interested in records concerning manufacturing controls, quality assurance, laboratory testing, investigations of deviations, and deficiencies potentially affecting extended-release pharmaceutical products.

Please provide all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions of responsive records. If any information is withheld, please identify the applicable FOIA exemption and provide sufficient information to describe the withheld material.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Emma Yasinski

title: Ithaca Officials' Communications Regarding Cornell University

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I hereby request the following records:

I request the following records held by the Ithaca Mayor's Office, Common Council, and City Attorney's Office, covering September 1 through October 21, 2026, concerning Cornell University's response to the Jane Doe sexual-assault allegations and resulting public controversy:

- Communications with Cornell: All emails, text messages, correspondence, and meeting records involving Cornell administrators, University Relations, Cornell University Police, university attorneys, or other representatives concerning the allegations, Cornell's institutional response, public criticism, or reputational concerns.

- Public Relations and Messaging: Communications, draft statements, talking points, and internal discussions concerning the City's public response, media inquiries, press coverage, and coordination of messaging with Cornell or other government agencies.

- October 8 Permit Moratorium: Communications, drafts, meeting records, and briefing materials concerning the Common Council's moratorium on Cornell-affiliated event permits, including discussions with Cornell representatives about the resolution, its potential consequences, or possible modifications.

- Interagency Communications: Correspondence with the Tompkins County District Attorney, Ithaca Police Department, Governor's Office, New York Attorney General, or New York State Police concerning Cornell's response, public statements, law-enforcement accountability, or the City's actions.

Please include responsive records maintained by city officials or staff, including emails, attachments, electronic messages, and calendar entries.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Michael Tracey

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

request copies of public records regarding municipal code enforcement actions within Del City.
Specifically, I am requesting a digital copy, spreadsheet, or log of all code enforcement violations, citations, and notices issued by the City of Del City from January 1, 2026, through the date this request is processed.
To limit the scope of clerical search time, please provide this information in its native electronic format (such as an Excel, CSV, or text file). The data fields requested include, but are not limited to:
• The street address or parcel number of the violation
• The date the violation was recorded or notice was issued
• The specific municipal code section or violation type (e.g., tall grass, junk/trash, derelict vehicles)
• The current status of the violation case
If this agency does not maintain a centralized log or spreadsheet containing these fields, please provide the underlying raw data sheets or records from which this information can be extracted.
If there are any fees for searching or copying these records, please inform me if the cost will exceed $25.00 before fulfilling this request. However, I would request a waiver of all fees as the disclosure of this information is in the public interest.
If any portion of this request is denied or redacted, please specify the exact statutory exemption under the Oklahoma Open Records Act that justifies the omission.
Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

AJ Keys
